mapper.select: SELECT id, name, mbid, listeners, playcount, bio_summary, last_fetched_at, created_at FROM artists WHERE LOWER(name) = LOWER(#{name})
SELECT id, name, mbid, listeners, playcount, bio_summary, last_fetched_at, created_at FROM artists WHERE LOWER(name) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%'))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO artists (id, name, mbid, listeners, playcount, bio_summary, last_fetched_at, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{mbid}, #{listeners}, #{playcount}, #{bioSummary}, #{lastFetchedAt}, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE artists SET mbid = #{mbid}, listeners = #{listeners}, playcount = #{playcount}, bio_summary = #{bioSummary}, last_fetched_at = #{lastFetchedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
